note: Chaos strat catalog for Roulette. Tokens: @DIR @RIFLE @PISTOL @SITE @SHOTGUN @SMG @LMG @SPECIAL. No HTML.

reg.description: The player with the most cash must buy for everyone on the team, nobody else can purchase anything (not even armour).
If someone on your team kills the enemy teams top or bottom frag, the player who killed them cannot do anything until the round ends.
You can only buy 1 item this round.
You can only buy duplicates of things your team already owns (somebody carried over a @RIFLE from the previous round? you can buy that gun again).
Buy a weapon you haven't used this game.
You can only say swear words, the word 'A', and the word 'B'.
When the timer hits 1:00 everyone must stop moving and shooting.
If you kill the person parallel to you on the scoreboard (top frag kills top frag) then the player who killed them cannot do anything until the round ends.
Guns cannot be used until a knife, zeus, or grenade kill is achieved by anyone on the team.
You cannot use your primary, until you get a kill by other means (pistols, knife, etc.).
Only crouch walking and Dual Berettas.
Move slowly as a group and throw ALL of your nades at the first enemy you see.
If anyone on the team dies, they must blow into their mics until the round ends.
You only have 1 shot, however if you get a kill you may shoot again.
You have to copy the crosshair of the enemy's bottom frag.

reg.callout: How does he play with this?
reg.description: You have to copy the crosshair of the enemy's top frag.
Set your crosshair's alpha value to 0.
Everyone buy a decoy grenade and throw it @SITE, then stack @SITE.
Everyone must group up, then upon coming to an intersection must draw an arrow with bullets indicating where they are going, take turns drawing arrows.
You can only get kills with @SMG in the air.
@SPECIAL must use an M249 (or negev if too expensive) and armour, everyone else must use a PP-Bizon and no armour.
Everyone must play with +@DIR typed into the console (after the round you can stop it by replacing the + with a -).
Upon getting a kill you MUST use the weapon your victim dropped, no getting attacking before you pick up their weapon.

@SPECIAL is the president, they must get rid of all their weapons. The rest of the team has to protect them at all costs while yelling secret service quotes ('GET DOWN MR.PRESIDENT', 'BREACH BREACH BREACH', etc.).
You must use whatever the F3 autobuy gives you.
The only movement key you can use is S.
The only movement keys you can use are A and D.
Switch your mouse hand and your keyboard hand.
Do 2 random Strats and do your best to complete both of them at once.
Everyone buy a @LMG (or a PP-Bizon ONLY if you are too poor), once you start firing you cannot stop, when you run out of ammo you cannot attack.
Before the round starts everyone type 'finna shoot you up' then buy an @SMG and preform 'drive-bys' on the enemy, never stopping.
If your score on the leaderboard is even, you can use a @RIFLE and armour, if it is odd then you can only use a @SHOTGUN and @PISTOL with no armour.
If you get a headshot you cannot do anything until the round ends, aim for the body!
To kill an enemy you must first hit them once with your pistol, then you must finish them off with your primary.
Each person must pick one of these weapons: @SMG, @RIFLE, @SHOTGUN, @LMG, and @PISTOL. No weapon can be repeated.
If you have over $4000 buy a @SHOTGUN, otherwise use whatever guns you can find from dead enemies.
Have your team drop all their weapons. Have 2 members buy either a @RIFLE or @LMG, those are the only guns that can be used, when those people die pick up their gun.
Buy a Negev and a decoy grenade and ruin your enemies ears.
When you kill an enemy you must drop everything and type the enemys name into chat.
When you kill an enemy you must drop everything and type the name of the gun you killed them with into chat.
The person with the most money must get the first kill before anyone else can attack, if they die before they get a kill then the next highest person takes their place.
You may only use your @DIR hand to play.

reg.callout: One Clip to Rule Them All
reg.description: Buy a @RIFLE or @SMG (your choice) and win the round without ever reloading.
3 people go @SITE with @SMG, the remaining 2 go to the other site with @RIFLE, once you reach your assigned site you cannot leave it.
All callouts need to be rapped.
Every player buys their most hated gun and gives it to a teammate.
Every player buys their most hated gun and gives it to a teammate.
Before shooting your primary you must first get a kill with a zeus, if you miss with your zeus you can only use your knife.
You must crouch the whole round (use +duck if you would like).
No jumping, crouching, walking, or aiming down sights.
You cannot attack until you lose health because of an enemy.
You can only use guns while at 100 health.

reg.callout: I've Got You in My Sights
reg.description: Scope for the whole round, never unscope.
You cannot touch your mouse until the timer hits 1:15, however you can use your keyboard.
Set CS:GO's 'master volume' to zero.
@SPECIAL and the top frag must play with their eyes closed.
You must hold the W key, no other movement keys can be pressed.
Spam Jump for the whole round, mouse wheel is your friend here.
Only two people can leave spawn at one time, upon one of them getting killed one more person can leave spawn.
Only two people can leave spawn at one time, upon one of them getting killed one more person can leave spawn.
You can only use weapons that have skins with qualities purple or above (zeus is also allowed).
You can only use weapons that don't have skins (zeus is also allowed).
You can only buy this round if you didn't get a kill last round.
Your team must compose of one of each rifle (ex. one Scout, one awp, etc.).
Your team must compose of one of each SMG (ex. one UMP, one P90, etc.).
The person with the most assists is the only one allowed a mic, everyone else must mute themselves.
Rush into the enemy spawn with a @SHOTGUN or @SMG, once you reach there you can return to the regular game.
Buy a Shotgun or a Sniper and everytime you fire you have to yell 'PUUULLLLLL!' as if you were on a shooting range.
You can only fire a single bullet before you have to reload your gun.
Turn down your resolution to the lowest it will go (take a timeout if nessessary).
You must buy 4 grenades and throw them all before shooting your gun.
Nobody on your team can be using the same gun, pistols included.
Nobody can be in the same room as another person.
Refer to everything as 'amigo' and speak in an awful Spanish/Mexican accent.
Buy grenades first, throw ALL of them @SITE, then run back to the other site.
Promote the fake cheat GOGlobal.cheat by typing things into chat like 'subscribe to GOGlobal.cheat for free aim haks'.
You must incorrectly callout everything.
If you kill an enemy you must take their gun back to spawn and place it in a pile.
@SPECIAL must pick which team mates get each of these weapons, each weapon can only be used by 1 person. @RIFLE, @SMG, @LMG, @SHOTGUN, @PISTOL.

The top frag must pick one of these options:

1. Everyone stack @SITE site with @LMG.

2. @PISTOL only.

The middle frag must pick one of these options:

1. Only @SMG and @PISTOL with no armour or grenades.

2. @SHOTGUN and no pistol with armour and grenades.

The bottom frag must pick one of these options:

1. The bottom frag is the only one allowed to have armour.

2. Everyone but the bottom frag can have armour.
If you go @SITE you have to use an @SMG or @SHOTGUN, if you go to the other site you have to use a @RIFLE.
If you use armour you have to use a shotgun, if you don't have armour you can use anything other than a shotgun.
Everytime you are running you have to make car noises.

ct.description: Use only CT specific guns, no rifles.
Buy a FAMAS and whenever you aren't shooting, hold down the 'scope button'.
Only silenced weapons are allowed, you must walk constantly, and you can only whisper into the mic.
Hide in spawn until the bomb is planted, then you may leave.
Nobody can use guns until one member of your team makes it to the enemy spawn.
Everyone tries to Ninja Defuse (defuse in smoke infront of the enemy team).
Everyone stack @SITE and hide in smoke until the bomb is planted.
One person buys a @LMG or @SHOTGUN (your choice) and armour, while everyone else ONLY buys a defuse kit. Only when the juggernaut dies can anybody else attack.
Constantly run between A and B until the bomb is planted.
Make a 2 man tower on each bomb site, the person on top has to use a @LMG or @RIFLE (your choice), the person on bottom has to use a @SMG.
You cannot defuse the bomb, you better rotate quick.
Buy smokes and decoys, throw all of your decoys at @SITE then hide in smoke on the other site.
Buy smokes and decoys, throw all of your decoys at @SITE then hide in smoke on the other site.
The 3 top frags try their absolute best to win the round, the others try to stop them without directly hurting them (ex. you can flash, body block, etc.).
The 4 bottom frags try their absolute best to win the round, the top frag trys to stop them without directly hurting them (ex. you can flash, body block, etc.).
Every one with an even score on the scoreboard trys their absolute best to win the round, the others try to stop them without directly hurting them (ex. you can flash, body block, etc.).
You must follow the plan layed out by your teams bottom frag, you also must insult the plan for its every possible failure.
The bottom frag camps on @SITE, everyone else goes to the other site, you can only rotate if the bottom frag dies.
You can only buy if you have over $5000.
Kill 4 enemies, then let the last plant the bomb, then kill them.
Everyone buy a MAG-7, when you get a kill with it drop everything and type in chat 'swag-7 :)'.
Grab a shotgun and run back and forth between CT spawn and T spawn until the bomb is planted.
Everyone hide in bank and argue about the economy until the bomb is planted.
Have everyone hide in heaven, when the bomb is planted smoke off the entrance to heaven and jump down.
Before anybody can shoot their guns they have to jump into the fountain.
Everyone hide in ladder room until one of you gets a kill, then you may leave.
Have everyone hide behind the oil tanker until bomb is planted.
Everyone buy a @SHOTGUN and decoy grenades and rush up B ramp. Then down ladder if they go A.

t.description: Use only T specific guns, no rifles.
Rush @SITE with only the Glock while holding down the 'scope button'.
Once the bomb is planted you can no longer move.
While you are holding the bomb you cannot move.
The bomb carrier must throw away all their weapons and can only crouch walk.
Use 10 flashes to rush @SITE with no regard for flashing your teammates.
Make a 'smoke train' to silently enter the bomb site.
Have the bomb carrier rush @SITE and (probably) die, everyone else must first go to the other site before retrieving the bomb.
If your score on the scoreboard is even then go @SITE, otherwise go to the other site. You cannot leave your site until the bomb is planted.
4 players rush while the other stays behind 'inspiring' them.
Rush @SITE, then T spawn, then back to the site, then plant.
The bomb carrier buys a @SMG and does whatever they want, the remaining people pair up and must face their partner.
The bomb carrier is the only one on the team who can buy weapons for the whole team.
Rush the tighest chokepoint on the map one by one.
You can't enter a bomb site until there is 30 seconds remaining.
Nobody can leave spawn until one of your teammates gets a kill.
Plant the bomb using only grenades, once the bomb is planted you can use your guns.
Follow this plan: Mid -> @SITE -> CT Spawn -> Then plant on @SITE.
Follow this plan: Mid -> @SITE -> Fake a plant on @SITE -> Fake a plant on @SITE -> Then plant on @SITE.
The bottom frag trys their absolute best to lose the round by flashing their team, body blocking, stealing the bomb, etc.
You can spend a max of $1500 this round.
Everyone buy a MAC-10, when you get a kill with it drop everything and type in chat 'big mac?'.
Playground -> Long -> Bathrooms -> Connector -> Water -> B
Monster -> Water -> Connector -> Bathrooms -> Long -> A
Rush long making as much noise as possible, what could go wrong?
Before leaving spawn have the bomb carrier lead you in some exercises.
A Main -> Ladder -> T Spawn -> Ivy -> A
Ivy -> A -> Ladder -> B

ct.description: Everyone run up mid to T spawn, once you reach T spawn you may play as normal.
Don't leave CT Spawn until someone one your team gets a kill.
The person with the lowest competitive rank has to buy guns for the entire team, and craft the strategy.

t.description: Everyone buy a P90 speak in a Russian accent and RUSH B, CYKA BLYAT.
Suicide -> Cat -> A -> CT Spawn -> B
Long -> A -> CT Spawn -> Mid -> Cat -> A

ct.description: Everyone needs to sit at snipers nest, nobody can leave until one of you gets a kill.
Everyone buy a @SHOTGUN and hide at the truck under appartments on B, nobody can leave until one of you gets a kill.
Everyone buy a @SHOTGUN and hide under palace, nobody can leave until one of you gets a kill.

t.description: Have the bomb carrier wait at A main, everyone else goes palace, the bomb must run in first and yell 'LEEROY JENKINS'.
Mid -> Boost into Snipers -> Market -> B
Mid -> Cat -> B -> Apartments -> Underpass -> Connector -> A

ct.description: Everyone must buy an incendiary, HE, smoke, and a flashbang. Once you throw all of the nades down banana you may use your guns.
Have everyone hide in smoke on pit.
Have everyone go chapel near B, have one of your team lead you all in prayer.

t.description: Have the bomb carrier close his eyes and run up banana, try your best to not let them die.
Alt Mid -> Apartments -> Boiler -> Mid -> Banana -> B
Everyone silently hide at the base of mid (near the stairs of one of the buildings), wait there until some gets a kill. Once someone gets a kill throw smokes top mid and RUSH B.

ct.description: Boost 4 people onto the boxes in ramp room, the last person tries to bait the people into ramp room.
Have everyone wait in smoke at heaven, when the bomb is planted jump down.
Everyone go either ramp room or squeaky to the vents, hide in them until one person gets a kill.

t.description: Everyone stay on the rafters in lobby until the timer hits 20 seconds, then run into A quickly.
Outside -> Secret -> Vents -> A -> Squeaky -> Ramp -> Heaven -> A
Ramp -> Heaven -> A -> Vents -> B

ct.description: Have 5 people watch mid, 3 on the window, 2 on the door.
Everyone sit perfectly silently heaven, when they start planting jump out at them.
Everyone stand on eachothers heads behind squeaky door, when the enemys turn the corner they should see 5 people on each others heads.

t.description: B Main -> Boost into Vents -> Mid -> Mid Room -> A.
Have 1 person go A, sit in smoke and just open and close squeaky until they die. As soon as they die, rush B.
Go mid to vent, but have 5 people sit in the vent until you get a kill. Once somebody gets a kill you may leave.

ct.description: Everyone stack Donut with @SHOTGUNs. Nobody leaves until one of you gets a kill.
All five wait in Temple/A site. First contact, everyone peeks together yelling the same word.
Everyone hide in Cave/B. Absolute silence until an enemy walks in, then all swing.

t.description: Rush Mid doors as a five-stack. First person through must yell a movie quote.
A main → Temple → plant. Nobody uses guns until a util kill or knife touch.
All five through Cave/B. Bomb carrier plants while everyone else jumps on the same box.

ct.description: Everyone hold Mid bridge with @RIFLEs. Nobody rotates until one of you gets a kill.
Stack Canal/B with @SHOTGUNs. First footsteps, all swing at once.
All five sit Palace/A. You may only leave after someone on the team dies.

t.description: Take Mid bridge control, then everyone must jump into water before committing a site.
Slow walk Canal as a group humming the same tune. Plant B default, then dance.
Rush Palace/A. Bomb goes first. Everyone else buys only @PISTOL and flashes.
